title: A股热筹监控
note: 首次入库的盘前监控；Cursor 页面已被后续交易日原地覆盖，历史正文见当日 Notion 条目。
noteEn: The first pre-market monitor filed in this log. The Cursor page has since been overwritten in place by later trading days; the historical wording is in that day's Notion entry.

title: A股热筹监控
note: 午前同时点成交约 1.18 万亿元，较昨日同时点放量约三成，宽度偏弱；半导体与元件走强，光模块冲高回落，影视走弱。谨慎跟：先观察东山精密与剑桥科技，不追中际旭创，不跟影视。
noteEn: By late morning, same-time turnover was about RMB 1.18 trillion, roughly 30% higher than yesterday at the same time, with weak breadth. Semiconductors and components were strong; optical modules spiked and then fell back; film and television weakened. Follow with care: watch 东山精密 and 剑桥科技 first, do not chase 中际旭创, and do not follow film and television.

title: A股热筹监控
note: 11-12 两市放量下跌、宽度塌陷，隔夜英伟达已官方确认黄仁勋辞职；今日跟筹建议为暂不跟，先看中际旭创对隔夜冲击的定价。
noteEn: On 12 Nov both exchanges saw higher turnover but lower prices, with breadth collapsing. Overnight, NVIDIA officially confirmed Jensen Huang's resignation. Today's follow-the-money advice is not to follow; first watch 中际旭创's pricing of the overnight shock.

title: A股热筹监控
note: 11-13 两市缩量下跌、宽度继续塌陷，光模块与 PCB 领跌；今日跟筹建议为暂不跟，先看中际旭创对隔夜芯片链的继续定价，影视反包只观察不跟。
noteEn: On 13 Nov both exchanges saw shrinking turnover and further breadth collapse, with optical modules and PCB leading the decline. Today's follow-the-money advice is not to follow; first watch 中际旭创's continued pricing of the overnight chip chain, and treat the film-and-television rebound as observation only.

title: A股热筹监控
note: 11-19 两市缩量下跌、宽度极差（638 涨 / 4532 跌），资金抱团半导体与光刻胶，影视院线与算力/IT服务撤离；隔夜纳指 -2.25%。今日跟筹建议为暂不跟，只条件式观察中芯国际与江化微能否扛住隔夜芯片下跌。
noteEn: On 19 Nov both exchanges fell on shrinking turnover with extremely weak breadth (638 up / 4,532 down); money crowded into semiconductors and photoresist while film-and-television and computing/IT services were abandoned. Overnight the Nasdaq fell 2.25%. Today's follow-the-money advice is not to follow; only conditionally watch whether 中芯国际 and 江化微 can withstand the overnight chip sell-off.

title: A股热筹监控
note: 11-20 两市放量普跌（官方成交 14238.59 亿、+9.00%），资金由科技成长撤向红利权重，PCB 小票逆势补涨；隔夜纳指 -5.28%、英伟达 -14.01%，总判暂不跟，首盯中京电子、超声电子。
noteEn: On Nov 20 A-shares fell broadly on higher turnover (official ¥1.424tn, +9.00%) as money rotated from tech into dividend heavyweights while small-cap PCB names rallied; with the Nasdaq -5.28% and Nvidia -14.01% overnight, the call is no follow, watching Zhongjing Electronics and CSG Ultrasonic first.

title: A股热筹监控
note: 11-23 两市放量普涨（官方成交 15548.81 亿、+9.20%，4306 涨 / 780 跌），资金由红利权重回流科技成长，人形机器人掀涨停潮；隔夜英伟达因黄仁勋复职 +31.48%，总判谨慎跟，主路径机器人核心，AI 硬件先看高开承接。
noteEn: On Nov 23 A-shares rallied broadly on higher turnover (official ¥1.555tn, +9.20%; 4,306 up / 780 down) as money rotated from dividend heavyweights back into tech growth and humanoid robotics saw a limit-up wave; with Nvidia +31.48% overnight on Jensen Huang's reinstatement, the call is cautious follow, led by core robotics names while AI hardware must first hold its gap-up.

title: A股热筹监控
note: 11-24 两市放量但分化（官方成交 16585.23 亿、+6.67%，1838 涨 / 3267 跌，涨停 151→55），AI 硬件高开低走；隔夜费半 -7.88%、英伟达 -5.86%，总判谨慎跟（条件式），首盯机器人核心拓普集团，工业富联观察，AI 硬件不跟。
noteEn: On Nov 24 A-shares traded heavier but split (official turnover ¥1.659tn, +6.67%; 1,838 up vs 3,267 down; limit-ups fell from 151 to 55) as AI hardware faded after a gap-up; with the SOX -7.88% and Nvidia -5.86% overnight, the call is cautious, conditional follow on robotics core Tuopu, watch Foxconn Industrial Internet, skip AI hardware.

title: A股热筹监控
note: 11-25缩量普跌，半导体与机器人核心破位，资金转医药银行防御；隔夜费半深跌后收复，总判暂不跟，光模块天孚、中际观察待确认。
noteEn: Nov 25 saw a low-volume broad sell-off as chips and robotics leaders broke down and money rotated to pharma and banks; with US chips recovering overnight, the call is no follow, with optical modules (Tianfu, Zhongji) on conditional watch.

title: A股热筹监控
note: 11-26 两市缩量震荡（官方成交 13185.67 亿、-4.82%），宽度修复但科创50 续跌，光模块与 PCB 结构性反弹，周期与银行护盘；隔夜美股感恩节休市。总判谨慎跟（条件式），主路径中际旭创、新易盛，开盘守住 11-26 低点再跟。
noteEn: On 26 Nov both exchanges were choppy on shrinking turnover (official turnover RMB 1,318.567 billion, down 4.82%). Breadth improved but the STAR 50 kept falling; optical modules and PCB rebounded in a split tape while cyclicals and banks supported the index. U.S. stocks were closed for Thanksgiving. Today's follow-the-money advice is a conditional cautious follow: the main path is 中际旭创 and 新易盛, only after the open holds the 26 Nov lows.
